namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays wherever the composition is created; only the page objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees /settings in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. `devs` is deliberately NOT a default — keeping it out is the point of the split (#261). No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults, so one here would silently re-assert itself over a group set through componentValues. The chart default lives in values.yaml instead.
readerGroups.title: readerGroups
